notes: GAAP city, aligned with FY2023/FY2024 choices. Governmental lines from the Total Governmental Funds column of the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures and Changes in Fund Balances (pp6-7; Total column p7). 'Bond/loan proceeds' 3,200,000 is printed among revenues (inside Total revenues), so it is a receipt line (Debt Proceeds), not debt_proceeds. Business-type lines from the proprietary Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Net Position, enterprise Total column (pp10-11); internal service funds excluded (combining statements pp26-27 not recorded). Business-type receipts total = operating + nonoperating revenues (computed); disbursements total 14,183,757 printed on the Statement of Activities (p2) = operating expenses 14,161,019 + interest expense 22,738. Business 'Other revenue' 9,611 is Miscellaneous general revenue on the Statement of Activities (p3), so it stays other. Proprietary cash flows from the enterprise Total column (p13). ending_cash = Total Governmental Funds Cash and cash equivalents 4,417,658 (p5); restricted cash 7,361,332 and county treasurer cash 72,649 not included (as in FY2023). Balance sheet from the government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1), each line by Governmental/Business-type column; internal balances net to zero. Detail: budgetary comparison schedules (budget basis) for General, Street, Sales Tax, Debt Service, Redevelopment and Airport funds (pp16-21); bond/loan/loan proceeds lines printed inside Total resources recorded as revenue; Debt Service Fund schedule prints no total line; Sales Tax schedule prints no expenditure. Nonmajor combining statement (pp22-25) recorded per fund column (17 funds; Nuisance Cleanup has no activity). Capital outlay labelled with a function only where the fund names it (Street, Golf); Airport and Capital Projects capital outlay plain 'Capital Outlay'. ARPA Fund intergovernmental recorded as federal grants. Read pages 1-27 of 27
